declarations.description:
Live audio level as bars, a waveform or an orb: the mic meter of a call, the waveform of a voice message, the orb of
a voice assistant.

The level comes from the first source set: `stream`, a `MediaStream` (a microphone, a call participant's track),
analysed through Web Audio; `media`, an `<audio>` or `<video>` element that plays (same-origin, or served with CORS
and `crossorigin`, and given its source first: Web Audio cannot read another one, which is then left alone); or `level`, a number from 0 to 1
an app already has from its call SDK. With no source, `state` (`idle`, `listening`, `thinking`, `speaking`) animates
what an agent is doing while its audio plays elsewhere. `muted` draws a flat, greyed meter.

`speaking-change` fires when the level of a source crosses `speaking-threshold`, held for 300 ms so the pauses between
words do not flicker; `:state(speaking)` matches meanwhile. The visualizer draws only while it is on screen and the
page is visible. Under reduced motion it is a steady meter, updated four times a second, with no breathing or
travelling animation.

It is decorative (hidden from assistive technology) unless it has a `label`, which makes it an image of that name, for
an orb that stands on its own.
declarations.name: AudioVisualizer

cssProperties.description: Height of the bars and the waveform.
cssProperties.name: --c2-audio-visualizer--height

cssProperties.description: The orb's body; its highlight and shade are mixed from it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-audio-visualizer__orb--color

cssProperties.description: The bars, wave or orb of a muted source.
cssProperties.name: --c2-audio-visualizer__muted--color

members.name: level
members.description: A level from 0 to 1, for an app that has it from its call SDK. `stream` and `media` win over it.

members.name: stream
members.description: A `MediaStream` to analyse, such as a microphone or a call participant's audio track. Property only.

members.name: media
members.description: An `<audio>` or `<video>` element to analyse while it plays, set once it has its source. Property only.

members.name: state
members.description: What to animate when there is no source.

members.name: muted
members.description: A muted source: a flat, greyed meter.

members.name: speakingThreshold
members.description: Level from which the source counts as speaking.

members.name: label
members.description: Makes the visualizer an image of this name, for one that stands on its own. Decorative without it.

members.name: listenTimer
members.description: The slower loop that keeps reading an unseen source, so that speaking still starts and ends.

members.name: smoothed
members.description: The smoothed level of each bar, and of the whole source.

members.name: speaking
members.description: Whether the source is speaking, as `speaking-change` last said.

members.name: hasSource
members.description: A real source, as opposed to the animated `state`.

members.name: schedule
members.description: Starts the frame loop when there is something to animate and the visualizer can be seen; draws once otherwise.

members.name: sample

type.text: { bars: number[]; wave: number[]; level: number }

members.description: Reads the source (or the state) for this frame: the level of each bar, the waveform and the overall level.

members.name: draw
members.description: Writes a frame straight to the rendered nodes, without a Lit update. `settle` skips the smoothing.

events.name: speaking-change
events.description: Fired when the source starts or stops speaking. Does not bubble.
